fit_card: Scored this unreal butterfly print Y2K baby tee on Depop for just $18 and I am obsessed. Can't wait to lean into the nostalgic streetwear energy with baggy denim and chunky sneakers. It’s giving total early 2000s daydream.

Just scored this vintage light wash cropped denim jacket on Poshmark for only $42 and I'm already obsessed. I'm leaning hard into the 90s streetwear vibe today with a white ribbed tank, baggy dark wash jeans, and chunky sneakers for the ultimate double-denim moment. It's officially my new go-to layer for everything.

Scored these platform sneakers on Poshmark for just $48 and I am officially obsessed with the chunky sole. They give off the ultimate Y2K streetwear vibe whether I'm styling them with baggy dark wash denim or oversized neutral trousers. Can't wait to wear these everywhere!

Scored this Y2K baby tee with the cutest butterfly print on Depop for just $18 and I am obsessed. I’m leaning all the way into the vibe by pairing it with baggy dark-wash jeans and a cropped zip hoodie for a chunky sneaker street look. It's giving major early 2000s energy and I'm never taking it off.

Just scored these khaki low-rise cargo pants on Poshmark for only $27, and I am so obsessed! I’m totally leaning into the ultimate 2000s streetwear vibe by pairing them with a cropped zip hoodie and chunky sneakers. Honestly, my Y2K wardrobe has never looked better.
